tests.description: Identify the exact classic ESP32 DevKit pinout, the USB-powered 5V output and 3V3 output. Identify actual pogo and adapter dimensions before soldering. Confirm the four kit pieces fit the selected rows.
Unpowered A1: all six contacts within each column <1Ω; different columns >10MΩ with external links isolated. Inspect pin1 and the NODE header mapping.
Prototype disconnected from A1: measure USB 5V ≤5.25V and 3V3 3.20–3.38V. R_LIMIT is 560Ω ±1%, ≥0.25W. With its output shorted, source current ≤9.5mA; remove short before connecting the kit.

Place fake battery negative C1 / positive C2, 1kΩ resistor C2–C3, LED anode C3 / cathode C4, and kit jumper C4–C1. Prototype J_OUTPUT pin1→A1 J_NODE pin3 and pin2→pin1. No final-power or matrix cable connected.

Compatible factory firmware: GPIO32 LOW/reset makes LED OFF; explicit enable lights LED; disable turns it OFF. Record USB-test-source voltage at C2 under load; it is intentionally unregulated and must not be called the final 5V rail.

items.title: J_CONTROL
items.description: J_CONTROL: control; Four individual flying leads from ESP1 prototype header. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1. Actual purchased dimensions must be measured before release. Breadboard terminals: USB_5V=j2, USB_3V3=j3, GND=j4, EDU_PWR_EN=j5. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: Q_PASS
items.description: Q_PASS: pass; USB high-side switch. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: G=a10, D=a11, S=a12. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: Q_ENABLE
items.description: Q_ENABLE: enable; 3.3V gate-control transistor. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: S=a17, G=a18, D=a19. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: R_GATE_OFF
items.description: R_GATE_OFF: gate off; 10kΩ makes the P-channel switch OFF. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: 1=c10, 2=c14. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: R_ENABLE_OFF
items.description: R_ENABLE_OFF: enable off; 100kΩ holds enable LOW. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: 1=e18, 2=e22. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: R_LIMIT
items.description: R_LIMIT: limit; 560Ω ±1%, 0.25W; bounds every educational-source path. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: 1=e11, 2=f11. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: J_OUTPUT
items.description: J_OUTPUT: output; Two flying leads: C2 positive / C1 return. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1. Actual purchased dimensions must be measured before release. Breadboard terminals: USB_TEST_LIMITED=j11, GND=j24. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: C_USB
items.description: C_USB: usb; USB3V3 fixture decoupling. Part of Default-OFF USB switch and bounded LED test source. Mount on the top side; red pad identifies pin 1.  Breadboard terminals: 1=f3, 2=f4. These are individual flying leads for headers, not a rigid plug.

items.title: final-source-transition

steps.title: Disconnect power and prepare
steps.instruction: Unplug USB and all educational sources before construction. Prototype source only: positive C2 / ground C1; final supply and matrix disconnected. OLED uses ESP1 GPIO4 SDA / GPIO16 SCL at 3.3V. Remove diagnostic probes before ordinary operation.
steps.why: Changing wiring while powered can invalidate measurements and connect incompatible power domains.
steps.expected: All sources isolated; identify this checkpoint’s links and equipment.

steps.title: Identify your hardware
steps.instruction: Confirm ESP32 DevKit model and labelled USB5V/3V3/GND/GPIO32 terminals. Identify the breadboard’s a–e / f–j connected rows and any broken supply rails. Measure actual pogo and adapter fit before permanent soldering.
steps.why: Finish and inspect this action before moving to the next one. Drawings describe the design; only your hardware inspection provides evidence.
steps.expected: Record exact board model and measured fit in notes. Do not guess the pinout.

steps.why: The app cannot command or measure an ESP32. A diagram or simulated camera approval is not a firmware test.
steps.expected: Compatible external firmware identified by revision. Implementation is not included; leave this step pending if firmware is unavailable.

steps.title: Measure and record
steps.instruction: With prototype source and diagnostic probes isolated as specified, compare capsule V(P1)−V(P2) with DMM at zero and the actual limited-source voltage. Error ≤0.10V+5%|reading|; ≥10 updates/s. All node absolute voltages 0–5.25V.
steps.why: The recorded hardware result is the evidence for this checkpoint.
steps.expected: Record actual readings, equipment, firmware revision and pass/fail. Fail or inconclusive prevents acceptance.

steps.title: Film the win
steps.instruction: The capsule reading follows the multimeter as loop voltage changes.
steps.why: Finish and inspect this action before moving to the next one. Drawings describe the design; only your hardware inspection provides evidence.
steps.expected: Demonstrate the positive and negative cases; keep actual measured evidence visible.

steps.title: Accept this checkpoint
steps.instruction: Verify the readings and construction, then accept CP07.
steps.why: Finish and inspect this action before moving to the next one. Drawings describe the design; only your hardware inspection provides evidence.
steps.expected: All required steps, assembly and fresh measured passes are complete.

steps.title: Disconnect power and prepare

steps.why: Changing wiring while powered can invalidate measurements and connect incompatible power domains.
steps.expected: All sources isolated; identify this checkpoint’s links and equipment.

steps.title: Disconnect power and prepare
steps.instruction: Unplug USB and all educational sources before construction. USB prototype source and prototype 3V3 links removed before final supplies connect. Use checkpoint-specific bounded test loads; stop and isolate power before changing any link. For smart-mode bench fixtures, disconnect both fixed battery leads and remove the initial kit loop. Output load: P3→1kΩ→LED anode, LED cathode→GND through removable leads. Logic inputs: HIGH=qualified3V3_SYS through1kΩ; LOW=GND through1kΩ. AND/OR exercise00,01,10,11; NOT exercise0,1. Never parallel another source with P3. Current tests use a documented series path, never an ammeter across the supply.
steps.why: Changing wiring while powered can invalidate measurements and connect incompatible power domains.
steps.expected: All sources isolated; identify this checkpoint’s links and equipment.

steps.title: Check the firmware contract
steps.instruction: smart factory mode on ESP2: migrate OLED/ADC service to its isolated position bus; register outputs OFF until qualified; valid heartbeat required
steps.why: The app cannot command or measure an ESP32. A diagram or simulated camera approval is not a firmware test.
steps.expected: Compatible external firmware identified by revision. Implementation is not included; leave this step pending if firmware is unavailable.

steps.title: Measure and record
steps.instruction: Power OFF to change the documented series fixture between 1kΩ and 470Ω. Compare OLED current with DMM; ≤0.20mA+5%|reading| error. Never put the ammeter directly across the supply.
steps.why: The recorded hardware result is the evidence for this checkpoint.
steps.expected: Record actual readings, equipment, firmware revision and pass/fail. Fail or inconclusive prevents acceptance.
